_about: MPPP site definitions: the sol range of each Navcam block that notebook 03 aligns. Keys are the site names used in folder names (<site>_colmap; <site>_colmap_zcam34 for the Navcam + Mastcam-Z 34 mm block). 'sols' = [first, last] sol of the block (inclusive); nearby waypoints (ADD_NEARBY_WAYPOINTS) can add other visits. 'zcam34' = true: the site also has a Navcam + Mastcam-Z 34 mm block (run_all_sites_zcam34.bat, run_sites.py --all --zcam). 'settings' = notebook 03 overrides for this site (JSON values), applied by scripts/run_sites.py and scripts/align_scape.py. 'no_mask_inference_at' = stations (S###D####) where the mask model is off. Groups name site lists for run_sites.py --group. Edit here, then run check_sites.bat; notebook 03 reads this file (SITES_FILE).
